reports.title: Nodes
reports.query: MATCH (n:Fringe) RETURN count(n)

reports.title: Relationships
reports.query: MATCH (:Fringe)-[e]->(:Fringe) RETURN count(e)

reports.title: Agents
reports.query: MATCH (a:Agent) RETURN count(a)

reports.title: Commits on dev
reports.query: MATCH (c:Commit) WHERE c.subject IS NOT NULL RETURN count(c)

reports.title: Nodes by label
reports.query: MATCH (n:Fringe) UNWIND [l IN labels(n) WHERE l <> 'Fringe'] AS label RETURN label, count(*) AS nodes ORDER BY nodes DESC

reports.title: Relationships by verb (with inverse)
reports.query: MATCH (:Fringe)-[e]->(:Fringe) RETURN type(e) AS verb, e.inverse AS inverse, count(*) AS uses ORDER BY uses DESC

reports.title: Agents crossing into other roles' lanes
reports.query: MATCH (a:Agent)-[:AUTHORED]->(c:Commit)-[x:CROSSES_INTO]->(lane:Role) WITH a, lane, count(DISTINCT c) AS n MATCH p = (a)-[:PLAYS]->(:Role) RETURN p, a, lane, apoc.create.vRelationship(a, 'CROSSES_INTO', {commits: n}, lane) AS crossing

reports.title: Lane crossings
reports.query: MATCH (a:Agent)-[:AUTHORED]->(c:Commit)-[x:CROSSES_INTO]->(lane:Role) RETURN a.name AS agent, a.role AS own_role, lane.name AS lane, count(DISTINCT c) AS commits ORDER BY commits DESC

reports.title: Shared files changed by others
reports.query: MATCH (owner:Agent)-[:OWNS]->(f:File)<-[:CHANGES]-(c:Commit)<-[:AUTHORED]-(a:Agent) WHERE a <> owner RETURN f.path AS file, owner.name AS owner, count(DISTINCT c) AS commits_by_others ORDER BY commits_by_others DESC

reports.title: Files with the most writers
reports.query: MATCH (a:Agent)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Commit)-[:CHANGES]->(f:File) RETURN f.path AS file, count(DISTINCT a) AS writers ORDER BY writers DESC LIMIT 12

reports.title: One run, A3 down to A0, with the keys that signed
reports.query: MATCH (r:Run) WITH r ORDER BY r.name DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH p = (r)-[:CONTAINS]->(u:Unit) OPTIONAL MATCH q = (u)-[:HANDS_TO]->(:Unit) OPTIONAL MATCH k = (:Key)-[:SIGNED]->(u) RETURN p, q, k

reports.title: Reach held without need, by altitude
reports.query: MATCH (u:Unit) WHERE u.reach_held > u.reach_needs RETURN u.altitude AS altitude, u.role AS role, count(u) AS units, round(avg(u.reach_needs),1) AS needs, round(avg(u.reach_held),1) AS held ORDER BY altitude

reports.title: Capabilities held without need
reports.query: MATCH (u:Unit)-[:EXPOSES]->(x:Reach) RETURN x.name AS reach, count(u) AS units ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

reports.title: ABP findings by agent and rule
reports.query: MATCH (f:Finding)-[:FLAGS]->(a:Agent), (f)-[:BREACHES]->(r:Rule) RETURN a.name AS agent, r.id AS rule, r.mode AS mode, count(f) AS findings ORDER BY findings DESC

reports.title: From a word to the commit that acted on it
reports.query: MATCH p = (:Person {id:'dinis'})-[:SAID]->(:Word)<-[:ACTS_ON]-(:Commit)<-[:AUTHORED]-(:Agent) RETURN p

reports.title: Words, agents and commits
reports.query: MATCH (:Person {id:'dinis'})-[:SAID]->(w:Word)<-[:ACTS_ON]-(c:Commit)<-[:AUTHORED]-(a:Agent) RETURN w.said_at AS said_at, w.text AS word, a.name AS agent, c.sha AS commit, c.at AS committed_at ORDER BY c.at DESC

reports.title: Span trees (Elastic swarm-flows)
reports.query: MATCH p = (:Span)-[:IS_CHILD_OF]->(:Span) RETURN p

reports.title: Spans by flow and altitude
reports.query: MATCH (s:Span) RETURN s.flow AS flow, s.altitude AS altitude, count(s) AS spans, max(s.duration_ms) AS longest_ms, sum(CASE WHEN s.finished THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS unfinished ORDER BY flow, altitude

reports.title: Communities, their events and topics
reports.query: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:IS_ORGANISED_BY]-(e:Event) WITH c, count(e) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8 MATCH p = (c)<-[:IS_ORGANISED_BY]-(:Event)-[:IS_ABOUT]->(:Topic) RETURN p

reports.title: Busiest organisers
reports.query: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:IS_ORGANISED_BY]-(e:Event) RETURN c.name AS community, count(e) AS events ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15
